messages:
Maya Nguyen: idea  run a 2% canary micro-feedback on new onboardings. one-question in-app survey, set CRM flag, notify owner. low lift.

Liam Patel: agree. need: feature flag, 1 reminder only at 48h, per-owner rate cap, kill-switch.

Ash Rivera: architecture: frontend -> webhook -> cs-events -> playbook-runner -> CRM update. will add dedupe on event_id.

Maya Nguyen: sample event: `{"account_id":"acct_123","owner_id":"u_jo","feedback":4,"comment":"smooth onboarding","event_id":"evt-abc"}`

Jo Chen: for scoring, suggest transient weight: feedback>=4 -> +5 for 7d; <=2 -> -3 for 7d. keeps long-term score stable.

Ash Rivera: draft playbook (staging):
```
id: fb-mini-001
trigger: onboarding_micro_feedback
sample_rate: 0.02
actions:
  - set_crm_field: micro_feedback_flag=true
  - route_to_owner: owner_field=owner_id
  - schedule_followup: delay=48h
meta:
  feature_flag: mini_feedback_lab_v1
  dedupe_key: event_id
```

Liam Patel: add owner rate limiter and global kill-switch. i'll write rollout/acceptance criteria: owner queue < 50, negative spike <5%, dup events <0.3%.

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: draft created in staging (fb-mini-001).

Ash Rivera: will implement webhook consumer with idempotency and per-owner throttling. sharing test curl later.

Maya Nguyen: plan: stage -> 2% prod via flag -> monitor 48h -> expand/pull. sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to triage.

Jo Chen: adding telemetry tag `mini_feedback_lab_v1` to metric events for A/B slicing.

Playbook Bot: scheduled staging deploy window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Maya Nguyen: thanks team. short thread, moving to #cs-ops for signoff.
